observation.visible_scene: A lit candle stands in a tall, clear glass holder with a blue base on a white tiled floor, in front of a white tiled wall. A large vertical mirror is positioned behind the candle; a hand at the upper-left edge grips the top of the mirror. The mirror produces a reflected image of the candle and flame, so two flame images appear vertically offset (the real flame and its reflection). For the first part of the clip a second hand at the lower left extends an index finger, pointing toward the candle/mirror.
visible_changes: The candle flame flickers continuously throughout, changing height and shape from frame to frame.
The pointing hand at lower left moves and blurs (frames ~1-17), then withdraws downward and leaves the frame (gone by frame ~19), after which only the upper-left holding hand remains.
The upper-left hand stays in contact with the mirror's top edge the whole time, with only small positional shifts.

The framing drifts slightly: the candle's horizontal position within the image and the visible left edge of the mirror shift gradually, indicating minor camera movement or small adjustment of the mirror.
The reflected flame/candle image persists in the mirror behind the real candle for the entire excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: The purpose or meaning of the pointing gesture and whether the hand would have returned.
The cause of the flame's flicker (e.g., air currents) and any events before or after this cropped segment.
The full extent and setup of the mirror and the person holding it.
uncertain_details: Whether the small frame-to-frame shifts of the candle and mirror edge are due to camera motion or to the holder adjusting the mirror.
The exact geometry producing the vertically offset real and reflected flame images (mirror tilt vs. reflection alignment) cannot be confirmed from the frames alone.
